description: Proposed refurbishment and repairs to the existing bridge from the pavement to the main entrance door. Replacement glazing to various lower ground floor windows and doors. New Victorian timber shutter to lower ground floor front windows. Existing low level brick planter in rear garden reduced in size. New timber framed secondary glazing to the second floor master bathroom suite.
